Multiplayer

Play online with friends: create a lobby and share its code, or join with a friend's code. Up to 8 players. Only your position is shared; your save stays on this computer.

Local server (this computer or your network)

Host uses the server running on this computer (npm run server, or npm run server:lan so others on your network can join). Join connects to someone else's.

Account

Sign in to keep your save in the cloud and carry on from any browser. Your game still works offline.
